notes.title: Steam Trading Cards 🃏🀄️🃏
notes.content:
Happy-creepy 2022, creatures from the other world! How are you?

To start this new era of darkness, we have a present for you that we brought directly from Chaos...

[b]THE BLACK HEART OFFICIAL TRADING CARDS![/b] ːpeketoː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/5be86670e161c23bc8da7563d618a29af4aec88e.jpg[/img]


That's it! Now, every time you play the game, you will get some cards. And to complete the set, you will need to trade them with other players.

And as you complete the sets, you will receive new badges from the game and also special items (like backgrounds or emoticons) to upgrade your Steam profile in black and red ːanimusː


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/c95864153f85217fac4ab179b01fec35051fd7c8.jpg[/img]


BTW, don't miss the Winter Sale discounts! You still have 24 hours left!

For you or a friend of yours, you can get the game and soundtrack at 20% OFF. And if you get both items with the Chaos Bundle, the discount goes to 32% 💸


https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23176/The_Black_Heart_Chaos_Bundle/


I want to take this opportunity to thank you all once again for supporting this amazing project of the creator Andres Borghi. We wish you all an amazing (and spooky) 2022 🎇

Follow us at our social networks to stay in touch:
[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/TheBlackHeartVg]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/TheBlackHeartVideogame]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=https://www.instagram.com/borghiandres/]Instagram (Andres)[/url]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/4bBsBQbWTu]Discord (fan made)[/url]
[/list]

Cheers, everybody! Take care!

[i]Tobías[/i]

notes.title: Game Update v1.5 ⚙️
notes.content:
[b]Fighters from this world and from the other! How are you?[/b] 👻

Since the release of last month, creator Andres Borghi has been working on improvements and fixes for The Black Heart. And today we have the new version 1.5 ready, which includes:

[list]
[*] New options on Practice Mode
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/9c5990c55900e8a95dc3dff707055e28321fe8ea.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixes and visual tweaks for the interface
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/cb594bd95caf20085e1acdfba405044336fe549c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/dc8bb89fbb7708e681f69d048570e50159d1b066.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Balancing improvements
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/e47963c7d619b03c40d383156d9657ca11f18d52.jpg[/img]

And a lot more! Below you will find the full change log 👇


Don’t stop playing the game and giving us all your valuable feedback! And remember to follow us on our social networks for more content:
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TheBlackHeartVg]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/TheBlackHeartVideogame/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/borghiandres/]Instagram (Andres)[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSJcyM3yQNxfBmTWIdDjtqw]You Tube (Andres)[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/hwaGsEQF9M]Discord (fanmade)[/url]
[/list]
Cheers and let’s try out the new 1.5 version!

[i]Tobias[/i]

-

[u]Lista completa de ajustes y mejoras en la nueva versión 1.5[/u]

General:
[list]
[*] Improved Practice mode with more options.
[*] Fixed image bug in movelists.
[*] Added macros to execute double punch or kick with 1 key.
[*] Updated engine to Ikemen_GO_v0.98.1
[*] In Practice mode you can choose any stage.
[*] Changed background animation in options menu.
[*] Every normal launcher can be blocked mid-air.
[*] Fatal moves performed in Practice mode don't produce bugs.
[*] Killer modes executed mid-combo consume half a green bar for every character.
[*] Normal weak jumping attacks produce more stunts to standing enemies to facilitate combos.
[/list]

Peketo:
[list]
[*] "tele-cut" uses 2 different animations varying between weak or strong.
[*] "Tele-cut" is slightly slower.
[/list]

Ananzi:
[list]
[*] "Super crawling birth" bounces only 2 times before disappearing.
[*] "Super crawling birth" allows only 1 egg onscreen.
[*] "Arachnid requiem" is faster and produces slightly more damage.
[*] Animation for "Super black trap" is a little faster during HIT.
[*] "Prey" is now overhead.
[*] You need more distance from the enemy to execute "Black trap".
[/list]

Animus:
[list]
[*] Weak "Nadasdy spear" now leaves the enemy closer when hit.
[*] JP-HK in dash is not overhead anymore.
[/list]

Shar-makai:
[list]
[*] "Saliva attack" is now a hard knockdown.
[*] St-hp has more reach.
[*] Fatal move has more reach and is unblockable.
[*] "Small army" allows to continue the combo.
[*] Jp-lp has cooldown to prevent constant spamming.
[*] Worm spawned in "Rock skull" now dies if Shar-makai is hit.
[*] St-hk is now overhead, except during combo.
[/list]

Hashi:
[list]
[*] "Seeding" tree now has more pushback when blocked.
[/list]

Noroko:
[list]
[*] "Snow woman" can be executed only 2 times without touching the floor.
[*] Reduced juggle.
[*] "Soul Punishment", "Bloody end" and "Kwaidan" have more recovery.
[/list]

Final:
[list]
[*] "Sanguimancy" clones now die after a certain time.
[/list]

Janos:
[list]
[*] Fixed some hitboxes
[*] "Negative saw is now executable in mid-air and is now a launcher.
[*] Projectiles in "Black blade" and "Black blades shred" are destroyed when clashing against an enemy projectile.
[*] "Dark puppet" clon has less life and last less time.
[*] There can only be 1 "Dark Puppet" onscreen.
[/list]

notes.title: 🔥 FULL GAME NOW AVAILABLE! 🔥
notes.content:
The long awaited day of launch has finally arrived! The definitive version of The Black Heart is ready on Steam to download and start killing  💀

And in the mid time, check out the amazing [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ehGC-Ne274]launch trailer[/url] created by Andrés Borghi, and discover the incredible story behind this ambitious project:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ehGC-Ne274][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/354c6375c173062917a8d42921d5266a439da48b.png[/img][/url]


As you can see in the video, besides Shar-makai’s chapter 6 from the Story Mode, THE PRINCE JANOS HAS ENTERED THE ARENA! Can you find him? Defeat him? And eventually control him?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/868a981fe1594acaf88f72dae2cd248679142d3b.png[/img]


The game now includes new songs and all the music has been remastered by audio specialist David Levill. You can listen to the full soundtrack in this new official DLC, which includes the work of Andrés and great guests Pablo Borghi, Miguel Borzi y Natacha Nocetti:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1786650/The_Black_Heart_Soundtrack/


We added over 30 unlockable palettes, most of them [url=[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1431780/view/2984183012667862396]]created by our lovely community[/url] ♥️

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1431780/view/2984183012667862396][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/3c420efcddf5400619018a7c60674b16637dabe6.jpg[/img][/url]


The new stage “The Pantheon”, the place where the king’s murder took place, which was only seen in the cinematics, is now available in-game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/a22dc2dbe9f534416981d70bdf02efa1d1a6a2e5.png[/img]


Speaking of cinematics, now you can rewatch them from the new gallery mode as you progress through the Story Mode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/7d681e072a28dc157010f940e3642e80474d6dbb.png[/img]


Lots of other features, fixes and improvements have been made for this new version1.4. You can check the entire list below 👇

It’s time now… Time to continue fighting in the search for The Black Heart 🖤

Thank you for your support. Enjoy!

[i]Tobías and Andrés[/i]

----

[u]Full list of chances and improvements from new version 1.4:[/u]

[list]
[*] New character Janos, available as enemy and as unlockable
[*] New chapter 6 of the Story Mode (Shar-makai)
[*] Character Final is now unlockable
[*] Over 30 new unlockable palettes 
[*] New levels The Phanteon and Csejthe Castle
[*] New songs added and all music is now remastered
[*] New gallery system to rewatch the animated sequences
[*] New unlock system for characters and levels
[*] New Easy difficulty
[*] Balanced the Normal difficulty
[*] Improved the fog in The Attic
[*] Improved stage Chaos
[*] Infinite continues in Story Mode
[*] Fatal move of Animus transforms Noroko and Ananzi their male versions
[*] First confrontation in Story Mode avoids mirror matches
[*] Killer Modes of Peketo and Shar-makai are more aggressive
[*] And there's something more...
[/list]

notes.title: 🖤 Full Release Announcement! 🖤
notes.content:
Creatures from the other world! How are you? 💀

We finally have a full Steam release date for The Black Heart:

🔥 [b]OCTOBER 21 IS THE DAY![/b] 🔥

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cDQcXFXPWFw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/9e2748f79ab6bfcc848c4be7f5ade9417c160a10.jpg[/img][/url]

In just 4 weeks, the game will go from the current Early Access state, to its FINAL form. And it will include:
[list]
[*] Chapter 6 of the Story Mode (Shar-makai)
[*] New and improved unlockable palettes for all characters
[*] A Gallery with all the cinematics
[*] Final as an unlockable playable character
[*] Remastered music by David Levill
[*] And also… A BIG SURPRISE! Which we’re going to reveal on launch
[/list]
Today starts the final countdown for a project in which Andrés Borghi started working almost 2 decades ago...

That’s why we want to ask you, our lovely and faithful fans from the other world, to follow and support us as much as you can during this campaign for the definitive release.

From Saibot Studios and together with Andrés, we’re going to post a lot of things in our social media accounts, so The Black Heart can reach even more gamers all around the world when the final release arrives. But we need your help 🙌


Follow us and share our posts:

[url=https://twitter.com/TheBlackHeartVg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/535f65055175aa28de57482bc914eb9280bc0ed0.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/TheBlackHeartVideogame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/1868565a2eb64216c2dbe28b95e14b49ce9a82d6.png[/img][/url]


Also follow Andrés Borghi on his personal accounts:

[url=https://www.instagram.com/borghiandres][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/8665f6d9e6e354c0a86d92d9b3bc904c88279ff7.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSJcyM3yQNxfBmTWIdDjtqw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/8d9f33a3d0a0048a5ffc4c4874879882d8c225ca.png[/img][/url]


And join us at the server created by fans:

[url=https://discord.gg/Hk3cdtFs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/e9978c09139c1205932d16c624c9011ac37bb1af.png[/img][/url]


Thank you once again for all your support. And get ready! Because the definitive version of The Black Heart WILL TEAR YOUR SOUL APART!

[i]Tobías and Andrés[/i]

notes.title: Chapter 5: The daughter of the prince (Ananzi) 🕷️
notes.content:
Beings from the other world! How are you today?!

The build update 1.3-EA4 for The Black Heart is finally ready. It includes the awaited chapter 5 of the Story Mode, starting the beautiful and ruthless Ananzi 🕸️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/41bd2276f01e3be35a9f7c3bd71ed538d4003df3.png[/img]


This update took more than expected because we have been trying to add a new feature and we still haven’t been able to make it. Hope we have some news about that in the future.

But besides the chapter 5 of the Story Mode, this new update also includes: characters palette selection, joystick thumbsticks implemented for movements, and a bunch of other fixes and improvements (see the entire list on the bottom 👇 ).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/5987486c08208edd172b3335e3f69ed167563cff.png[/img]


[u]All supported character palettes:[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/b9c22889e4e4e7142e97671db7ed7ebbe248e6cf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/a47e5ec1256f3d4309f67b664cff5149b3594959.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/bd1156fced47720fc4ef85f24aa36b6c4d0d6722.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/a825146328b5cbae57f47a9f4ef57c8423e968c6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/9be1348636c6f234c64386316293b51306270724.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/4303e4bd5a3ddea01cfba369d38e2411c39ce51b.jpg[/img]

[b]So what’s your favourite character and palette color? Let us know in the comments below![/b] 👹


With the creator Andres Borghi we’re getting closer to finishing the development of The Black Heart. Soon enough we’ll have a final and definitive version to release the game outside of Early Access...

See you in the arena, fighters! Have a bloody weekend!

[i]Tobías[/i]

-

[u]Full list of chances and improvements from new version 1.3-EA3:[/u]

[list]
[*] Fifth chapter of the Story Mode added (ANANZI).
[*] Menus are navigated with friendlier and well defined keys.
[*] Support for controller analog sticks added.
[*] New system to choose the color of the fighter.
[*] Only 2 difficulty levels like in the classic version: Normal and hard.
[*] The fatal move sign doesn't flash anymore.
[*] Fatal moves now have a more dramatic sound design.
[*] Elements were added to the background of the stage "The Desert".
[*] Noroko's and Ananzi's killer modes were modified to be more aggressive.
[*] Bug fixed in Shar-makai's supermove "Procreation".
[*] Hashi´s supermove "Super Fruti-toss" was improved.
[*] Ananzi's "Black trap" with Punch 2 now lasts longer.
[*] Ananzi's "Black trap" and "Super black trap" now hit falling enemies in juggle.
[*] Tag Mode was removed due to various internal engine problems.
[*] The Escape key in the main menu now selects the exit option, instead of abruptly closing the game.
[*] In options you can set how much life you gain after each survival match.
[*] Removed the possibility of changing characters after losing and continuing during Story Mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Chapter 3: The red dream (Peketo) 🔪
notes.content:
Creatures from the other world! How have you been? 💀

From the release on October, Andrés has been working on The Black Heart to bring you this new and terrorific update with "The red dream"...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/8d5c2837ff2b2b38b0eca6667e77ccc9d19d7b80.jpg[/img]

The third chapter of the story mode with Peketo is now available!

Also, a lot of fixes and improvements has been made based on your awesome feedback. Thanks for that!
So below is the full list of changes in this new version 1.3-EA2.

We're also trying to add new game modes, but we depend on the progress of the engine Ikemen for that. Hope we have news soon 🤞

Cheers and let's go cover in blood once again!

[i]Tobías[/i]

-

Full list of chances and improvements from new version 1.3-EA2:

- Third chapter of the story mode added (Peketo).
- Updated to the latest version of the Ikemen engine (V.96).
- Added 32 bit version (x86).
- Movelist is easier to understand.
- Screenshot folder added (F12 to generate a screenshot).
- Controls are more responsive.
- The game starts in windowed mode to avoid crashes (ALT+ENTER for fullscreen)
- Minimum distance for throws increased from 3 to 10 pixels.
- Animus' killer mode fire animation improved.
- Survival mode specifies which match you are in.
- The survival mode result screen includes both characters when in team mode.
- The survival mode result screen and continue screen have music.
- Time in matches increased to 99 seconds.
- Ananzi's killer mode improved.
- Continue option text reads better.
- Final boss' teleport spam limited.
- Noroko's Obon supermove can't hit enemies if they block while crouching.
- Direct body special moves require more time to reset, leaving the attacker open to counter attacks.
- Final boss combat is now just 1 round with more time (120 seconds).
- Added visual and sound cue that indicates that the power bar is full.
- The damage of all attacks was rebalanced.
- Combo dampener system added to reduce the total damage of big combos.
- Spanish version has menues in spanish.
- Shar-makai's rising sting special attacks leaves the enemy open for more combos.
